segments.name: Corporate
segments.evidence: Our Corporate segment primarily serves US private sector business customers with more than 250 employees.

segments.name: Small Business
segments.evidence: Our Small Business segment primarily serves US private sector business customers with up to 250 employees.

segments.name: Public
segments.description: Serves US government agencies and education and healthcare institutions with IT solutions.
segments.evidence: Our Public segment is comprised of government agencies and education and healthcare institutions in the US.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Comprises CDW UK and CDW Canada operating segments that do not meet reportable segment thresholds.
segments.evidence: We also have two other operating segments: CDW UK and CDW Canada, each of which do not meet the reportable segment quantitative thresholds and, accordingly, are included in an all other category ("Other").

revenueModel.text: Customers pay CDW for hardware, software, cloud and integrated IT solutions that CDW procures from vendor partners and wholesale distributors for resale.
revenueModel.evidence: We may purchase all or only some of the products and services our vendor partners offer for resale to our customers or for inclusion in the solutions we offer.
